caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed dress in a three-quarter rear view on the left side of the image, and a smaller simplified sketch of the dress in the upper right corner. The dress is floor-length with a voluminous skirt, rendered in light gray or off-white tones, featuring multiple bands of accent color in purple. There are ruffles and bands of purple trim along the edges of the skirt, the hem, and along the sides of the bodice and sleeves. The dress includes a bonnet or head covering that matches the dress, also adorned with purple trim and a bow. The drawing is composed on a lightly textured, off-white background with some visible discoloration and aging at the edges. The overall orientation and arrangement direct attention to the fabric details and decorative elements, with folds and shading to convey the structure and draping of the garment.
title: Dress
